The sentiment of the provided text is positive. The Italian phrase "Il tempo passato con la mia famiglia durante le vacanze è stato meraviglioso. Abbiamo creato ricordi che dureranno per sempre" translates to "The time spent with my family during the holidays was wonderful. We created memories that will last forever." The use of words like "meraviglioso" (wonderful) and the emphasis on lasting positive memories clearly indicate a happy and affectionate tone.
